library-lending/uncertainty/reservation-.why_it_matters: Decides whether a returned copy can sit unavailable indefinitely while other members wait.

options.label: Release the hold after 3 days and offer the copy to the next member.
impact: Release the hold after 3 days and offer the copy to the next member.
rule_claims: An uncollected hold expires 3 days after the copy is offered.
An expired hold passes to the next member in the queue.

options.label: Hold the copy until the member collects or cancels.
options.explanation: Fair to the first member but can stall the queue.
effects: Fair to the first member but can stall the queue.
impact: Hold the copy until the member collects or cancels.
rule_claims: A held copy stays held until collected or cancelled by its member.

options.label: Defer the decision and keep compilation blocked.
options.explanation: Not ready to choose a policy yet.

library-lending/uncertainty/renewal-with.why_it_matters: Decides whether reservations can be starved by repeated renewals.

options.label: Refuse renewal while another member has a reservation.
impact: Refuse renewal while another member has a reservation.
rule_claims: A loan cannot be renewed while the book has a reservation.

options.label: Allow a single renewal even with a reservation.
impact: Allow a single renewal even with a reservation.
rule_claims: A loan may be renewed once even when the book is reserved.
A second renewal is refused when the book is reserved.
